meaning:
σωρεύω
[in LXX: Pro.25:22 (חָתָה), Jdth.15:11 * ;]
(a) to heap on: with accusative before ἐπί with accusative, Rom.12:20 (LXX) (Arist., al.);
(b) to heap with: with accusative and dative, metaphorically, ἁμαρτίαις, 2Ti.3:6 (overwhelmed with, Field, Notes, 217) (Polyb.).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Therefore “If your enemy is hungry, feed him. If he is thirsty, give him a drink; for in doing so, you will heap coals of fire on his head.”
For some of these are people who creep into houses and take captive gullible women loaded down with sins, led away by various lusts,
